headword: {折|お}り{返|かえ}し{地点|ちてん}

definitions.gloss: turnaround point; halfway point; midway mark
definitions.explanation: The point at which one turns around and heads back, either literally (in a race or journey) or figuratively (the midpoint of a project, period, or process).

examples.japanese: マラソンの{折|お}り{返|かえ}し{地点|ちてん}に{着|つ}いた。
examples.english: I reached the turnaround point of the marathon.

examples.japanese: プロジェクトはようやく{折|お}り{返|かえ}し{地点|ちてん}を{過|す}ぎた。
examples.english: The project has finally passed the halfway point.

examples.japanese: {折|お}り{返|かえ}し{地点|ちてん}で{給水所|きゅうすいじょ}が{設|もう}けられていた。
examples.english: A hydration station was set up at the turnaround point.

notes: Compound of {折|お}り{返|かえ}し (turning back) + {地点|ちてん} (point/location). Often used in the context of marathons and running races where the course goes out and back. Also used figuratively for the midpoint of a time period, project, or life stage, as in {人生|じんせい}の{折|お}り{返|かえ}し{地点|ちてん} (the midpoint of life).
